description: Search Spica Post’s full catalog of 170+ tools by keyword or domain group (link pages, blog, templates, inbox, crosspost, auto-repost, Instagram auto-replies, short links, UTM, media kit, keywords, locations, Pinterest boards, batch ops, calendar sync, client reviews, team/approvals, audit, webhooks, exports). Returns exact tool names, safety hints, parameter limits and whether to call directly, via tools_read, or via tools_run. Changes nothing.

group.description: Optional domain group name (e.g. "Link page", "Inbox", "Articles", "Templates", "Auto-crosspost", "Approvals and audit", "Webhooks").

includeSchemas.description: Include full parameter lists with types and limits (default true when query or group is provided).

limit.description: Maximum tools to return (1 to 50). Defaults to 15.

query.description: Keyword or task to match tool names, titles, descriptions and groups (e.g. "link page", "blog", "inbox", "template", "webhook", "team").

name: tools_search
title: Search all Spica Post tools
